description: Seafloor crustal deformation data along the subduction zones around Japan obtained by GNSS-A observations is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Yusuke Yokota et al. Crustal deformation data obtained by geodetic observation networks are foundations in the fields of geodesy and seismology. These data are used to study plate motion and earthquake sources and for simulating earthquake and tsunami scenarios. Although relatively scarce, seafloor geodetic data are particularly important for monitoring the behaviour of undersea interplate boundary regions. Coverage: national (JP); published in 2018. Formats: TXT. The data are held in PANGAEA and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 39 data points. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-3.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
